headline: OpenAI updates the Agents SDK enhancing secure, long-running agent capabilities.

items.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
items.summary: OpenAI has updated the Agents SDK introducing native sandbox execution and a model-native harness. This update helps developers build secure and long-running agents capable of interfacing across files and tools more efficiently. By isolating agent operations, it enhances security and stability, which is crucial for complex deployments.
items.why_it_matters: This update provides critical improvements for developers building AI-powered tools, ensuring more robust and secure agent operations.

items.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, a new text-to-speech model that offers enhanced expressiveness through granular audio tags. These tags allow developers to direct AI speech generation with precise control, improving the quality and customization of audio outputs.
